digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review trigger system and documentation
propositions: The rebar project requires a noisy-tier trigger vocabulary layer to catch concurrency-related bugs that the committed high-precision tier misses, with three corpus bugs (fine-wisteria-solenodon, fervid-boring-python, eclectic-spotted-barb) only triggering through noisy tokens

A project-specific concurrency overlay must be added to .rebar/criteria_routing.json with trigger tokens for lock files, retry patterns, subprocess calls, and reconciler refs, along with glob patterns for relevant source paths

The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier at 13.3% fire rate vs. project noisy tier adding 22.0% for 35.3% combined) and its configuration mechanism must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with rebar as a worked example
A config-effect test must verify that diffs containing project-specific tokens like index.lock fire the concurrency overlay under effective routing but not under committed-only routing
